messages:
Marta Li: thinking about an interleaved bakeoff across hosted/dedicated/private for the new gptx-13b variant. want to test FP8, AWQ-int8, gptq-int8 in parallel and exercise our canary/fallback rules. short plan below.
Ryan Cho: nice — what's the failure criterion? do we gate on exact-match evals or on token-level metrics?
Marta Li: primary gate = goldenset QA + relative delta on Rouge/EM + latency corridor. quick rule: if quality delta > 0.8% absolute on goldenset OR latency > 2x baseline -> rollback.
Katie S: for hosted we should favour AWQ-int8 for cost but keep fp8 as safety variant. hosted canary = 1% user traffic, 10k requests or 48h whichever first.
Jifan: for private deployments we can't force AWQ; customer may prefer fp8 on their infra. propose we ship both quant profiles with model package and let private autoswitch only when goldenset passes.
Andre P: what about KV-cache correctness and generation drift? need trigram-level regression checks + sampling checks. add smoke evals for long-context coherence.
Marta Li: agreed. I'll add a small eval harness: ```bash
# smoke run
python eval/harness.py --model gptx-13b --quant awq --dataset goldenset --samples 500
``` 
Marta Li: also proposing 'interleaved corridor' routing: route 70% to primary quant, 20% to fp16 baseline for comparison, 10% to fallback variant. if baseline beats quant on quality by threshold -> auto-fallback.
DeployBot: canary created: canary/1955554321 on hosted-us-west-2, traffic=1%, monitor=goldenset/regressions, alert=on 0.8% delta.
Ryan Cho: how do we handle dedicated capacity mapping (GPU memory/throughput mismatch)?
Marta Li: for dedicated, preflight bench on a small shard: if peak mem > node capacity -> route to mixed-precision or lower batch size; fallback to dedicated-legacy profile.
Katie S: doc note: update rollout playbook with steps: 1) create canary 2) run smoke eval 3) wait for 24h telemetry 4) run full goldenset and latency curves 5) promote or rollback.
Jifan: I'll add automated checks to the CI pipeline to reject canary if eval missing or if NVTX errors appear.
Andre P: add a note about cost-outlier detection — if token cost drops >30% but quality delta >0.5% we need product review.
Marta Li: sweet. I'll open the bakeoff matrix and assign owners. @Ryan @Katie can you own hosted/dedicated respectively? :thumbsup: 
Ryan Cho: yep, taking hosted.
Katie S: ok for dedicated.
Marta Li: leaving private ownership to @Jifan. rolling this into next week's cadence meeting. thanks all :rocket:
